messages:
alex_dev: Heads-up — Datadog + OTEL nightly demo run is scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Want to confirm owners and the demo checklist.

kevin_partnerships: I can own partner comms and the slide deck. Will draft a short agenda. :+1:

tanya_pm: I'll own the runbook and acceptance criteria. Quick Q: are we demoing trace-linking from our GPU schedulers into DD APM?

sam_obs: yes — plan is to show trace spans from inference runtime -> router -> model worker, with flamegraph + latency distribution. Also will show sample dashboards and an alert firing.

kevin_partnerships: nice. can we also highlight the new OTLP exporter perf improvements? partners asked for numbers.

alex_dev: good call. sam, can you attach a small benchmark (p50/p95 token latency, qps) we can show in slides? even synthetic is fine.

sam_obs: will run quick nightly that outputs CSV. command I use locally: `./scripts/trace-demo --workload=gpt-medium --qps=50 --duration=120`

kevin_partnerships: for the partner-facing doc, we should include the minimal config snippet to enable exporting to Datadog. Tanya, can you add this to the runbook? e.g.:

```yaml
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}
    site: datadoghq.com
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
      grpc:
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

tanya_pm: on it. I'll paste into the runbook and add a note about sampling & resource limits.

alex_dev: who will run the demo infra (spin up staging stack + demo GPU nodes)? we need someone on-call for immediate reprovisioning.

sam_obs: I can boot the infra at 07:30 PT and validate exporters are sending traces. Will leave logs in the runbook.

kevin_partnerships: i'll coordinate with partners to join a 09:00 start, Q&A slot at 09:20. Also will prepare a 2-slide appendix about integrated alerts: `redwood-inference/high-latency` monitor + sample notebooks.

dd_onboarding_bot: Reminder: Datadog trial account expires in 3 days. Contact ops if you need extension.

alex_dev: thanks bot. sam — can you also add a quick snippet to reproduce the alert (so partners can try it)? something like `stress-client --rps 200 --tail-latency 300` that triggers the monitor.

sam_obs: yep, I'll include that and a `.dashboard.json` export that partners can import.

tanya_pm: PR opened for the runbook: https://internal.redwood/docs/runbooks/dd-otel-nightly-demo (please review before EOD).

kevin_partnerships: review done, left minor wording nits. otherwise looks good. I'll update the slide deck after you merge. :eyes:

alex_dev: perfect. final checklist: infra up by 07:30 PT (sam), runbook merged by EOD (tanya), slides + partner invites (kevin). If anything blocks, ping here or DM.

sam_obs: got it — will post the staging tracer rundown in this thread once infra is green.

kevin_partnerships: thanks team! excited to show the end-to-end trace flow and the latency improvements. :rocket:
